rows.col_1: GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/modelderivative/v2/designdata/{urn}/manifest
User context optional
data:read viewables:read
JSON

Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a two-legged access token obtained via a Client Credentials Grant flow, or a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow or a Secure Service Account (SSA) flow.
The SSA flow is designed for headless server-to-server operations. While it functions like a two-legged flow (no user interaction), it is classified as three-legged because it preserves user context.

A comma separated list of the algorithms you want the response to be encoded in, specified in the order of preference.
If you specify gzip or *, content is compressed and returned in gzip format.

Specifies the data center where the manifest and derivatives of the specified source design are stored. Possible values are:

US - (Default) Data center for the US region.
EMEA - Data center for the European Union, Middle East, and Africa.
AUS - Data center for the Australia region.
CAN - Data center for the Canada region.
DEU - Data center for the Germany region.
IND - Data center for the India region.
JPN - Data center for the Japan region.
GBR - Data center for the United Kingdom region.
The URL-safe Base64 encoded URN of the source design. This value is used as the urn URI parameter in operations to access data for this source design.
The manifest was successfully retrieved.

The server was unable to process the request. The syntax of the request is malformed or the request is missing a required header. Do not repeat the request without fixing the issue. The response body may indicate what is wrong with the request.
The supplied authorization header was not valid or the supplied token scope was not acceptable. Verify authentication and try again.
The request was successfully validated but lacking the required permissions. Verify your credentials and permissions before you send this request again.
The requested resource was not found. Review the request and try again.
An unexpected error occurred on the server, preventing it from completing your request. Please try again later. If the issue persists, contact the support team for assistance.
The service identifier. Comprises of the service name, version, and environment.
The service startup time, in the following date format: EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss Z yyyy.
The amount of time spent servicing the request, in milliseconds.
Provides information about server failures, if any.
The URL-safe Base64 encoded URN of the source design.
An array of objects, where each object represents a derivative of the source design.
The name of the source design.

true - The derivative has a thumbnail.
false - The derivative does not have a thumbnail.
Indicates the progress of the process generating this derivative, as a percentage. Once complete, the value changes to complete.
The file type/format of the derivative. Possible values are: dwg, fbx, ifc, iges, obj , step, stl, svf, svf2,  thumbnail.

A JSON object containing metadata extracted from the source design. This metadata provides valuable information about the model, such as its author, client name, project status, and other relevant details.
Note: This metadata is currently returned for the following source design types:

RVT - Revit models
NWD - Navisworks models
DWG - AutoCAD models
Status of the task generating this derivative. Possible values are: pending, inprogress, success, failed, timeout.
An array of objects where each object represents a message logged to the manifest during translation. For example, error messages and warning messages.
Indicates the type of the message. For example, warning indicates a warning message and error indicates an error message.
The ID of the message. For example, the error code reported by an error message.
A human-readable explanation of the event being reported. Can be a string or an array of string.
An array of objects, where each object represents a resource generated for the derivative. For example, a Model View (Viewable) of the source design.
An ID that uniquely identifies the resource.
Type of resource this JSON object represents.
The URN that you can use to access the resource.
File type of the resource.
MIME type of the content of the resource.
An ID assigned to a resource that can be displayed in a viewer.
The name of the resource.
Status of the task generating this resource; Possible values are:  pending, inprogress, success, failed, timeout

true - There is a thumbnail for the resource.
false - There is no thumbnail for the resource.
Indicates the progress of the process generating this resource, as a percentage. Once complete, the value changes to complete.

The name of the phase the resource file was generated from. This attribute is present only on Model Views (Viewables) generated from a Revit source design. This attribute can be a string (for Revit non-sheet 2D or 3D views) or an array of strings (for Revit sheet views).

The unique ID of the phase the resource file was generated from. This attribute is present only on Model Views (Viewables) generated from a Revit source design. This attribute can be a string (for Revit non-sheet 2D or 3D views) or an array of strings (for Revit sheet views).
The default viewpoint of a viewable 3D resource.
An array of two integers where the first number represents the width of a thumbnail in pixels, and the second the height. Available only for thumbnail resources.
Indicates the type of the message. For example, warning indicates a warning message and error indicates an error message.
The ID of the message. For example, the error code reported by an error message.
A human-readable explanation of the event being reported. Can be a string or an array of string.
An optional array of objects, where each object (of type children) represents another resource generated for this resource.

true - There is a thumbnail for the source design.
false - There is no thumbnail for the source design.
Indicates the overall progress of all translation jobs, as a percentage. Once all requested derivatives are generated, the value changes to complete.
The type of data that is returned. Always manifest.

Specifies the data center where the manifest, derivatives, and references are stored. Possible values are:

US - Data center for the US region.
EMEA - Data center for European Union, Middle East, and Africa.
AUS - Data center for the Australia region.
CAN - Data center for the Canada region.
DEU - Data center for the Germany region.
IND - Data center for the India region.
JPN - Data center for the Japan region.
GBR - Data center for the United Kingdom region.
Indicates the version of the schema that the manifest is based on.
Overall status of all translation jobs for the source design. Possible values are: pending, success, inprogress, failed, timeout.

headers = {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer eyJh...',  # Replace with your access token
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
